class Solution:
    def numberToWords(self, num: int) -> str:
        if num == 0:
            return 'Zero'

        lt20 = [
            '',
            'One',
            'Two',
            'Three',
            'Four',
            'Five',
            'Six',
            'Seven',
            'Eight',
            'Nine',
            'Ten',
            'Eleven',
            'Twelve',
            'Thirteen',
            'Fourteen',
            'Fifteen',
            'Sixteen',
            'Seventeen',
            'Eighteen',
            'Nineteen',
        ]
        tens = [
            '',
            'Ten',
            'Twenty',
            'Thirty',
            'Forty',
            'Fifty',
            'Sixty',
            'Seventy',
            'Eighty',
            'Ninety',
        ]
        thousands = ['Billion', 'Million', 'Thousand', '']

        def transfer(num):
            if num == 0:
                return ''
            if num < 20:
                return lt20[num] + ' '
            if num < 100:
                return tens[num // 10] + ' ' + transfer(num % 10)
            return lt20[num // 100] + ' Hundred ' + transfer(num % 100)

        res = []
        i, j = 1000000000, 0
        while i > 0:
            if num // i != 0:
                res.append(transfer(num // i))
                res.append(thousands[j])
                res.append(' ')
                num %= i
            j += 1
            i //= 1000
        return ''.join(res).strip()
